#### Lifecycle

```mermaid

    lineColor: "#888888"

---
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> DRAFT : createProduct
    DRAFT --> DRAFT : updateProduct
    PUBLISHED --> DRAFT : updateProduct
    DRAFT --> PUBLISHED : publishProduct
    DRAFT --> RETIRED : retireProduct
    PUBLISHED --> RETIRED : retireProduct
    RETIRED --> [*]
```

Field `status`, initial `DRAFT`.
